tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Solutions & Integration Architect | SAP Commerce Cloud, ERP, OMS & PIM Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend and integration specialist with 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience designing and developing platform architectures on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Extensive background guiding custom extension development, module architecture, and complex integrations across ERP, OMS, and PIM systems. Proficient in Java, Spring, RESTful OCC APIs, and microservices, bridging technical execution and business requirements to deliver scalable enterprise commerce solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce
cover_en.hook: Enterprise commerce success demands robust module architecture and seamless data flow across ERP, OMS, and PIM systems. With over five years of enterprise e-commerce experience across SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) environments at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in custom extension development and mission-critical multi-system integrations to Jobgether.

bullets.label: Module Architecture & Custom Extensions
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, customizing interceptors, populators, converters, and core modules to establish clean, maintainable platform architectures.

bullets.label: ERP, OMS & PIM Integrations
bullets.text: Architected and optimized end-to-end data pipelines connecting SAP ERP, MDM (Profisee), and OMS, resolving integration bottlenecks and keeping catalog and pricing data consistent across global enterprise channels.

bullets.label: Headless & RESTful API Strategy
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC RESTful web services for headless commerce and external integrations, engineering API migrations for customer account structures that improved transactional stability.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Solution Design
bullets.text: Analyzed complex business requirements with cross-functional international stakeholders, translating process flows into technical functional specifications and robust commerce solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work and residence permit with no sponsorship required. I am currently serving my notice period until 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my integration and architecture background can support your commerce initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: Jobgether's focus on connecting top-tier talent with flexible, international enterprise projects aligns with my experience delivering global e-commerce architectures. I am eager to apply my background in complex enterprise commerce platforms, custom module development, and multi-system integrations across ERP, PIM, and OMS to deliver high-impact commerce solutions for diverse client environments.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by architecting enterprise commerce platforms, guiding custom extension development, and engineering seamless integrations across ERP, OMS, and PIM systems to deliver resilient, scalable commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I noticed the Commerce Architect opening at Jobgether. With 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms, custom extension architecture, and complex ERP/OMS/PIM integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to connect and discuss the role.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Adobe Multi-Solution Architect, Adobe Commerce position at Jobgether.

With over five years of experience in enterprise e-commerce architecture, custom extension development, and ERP/OMS/PIM integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise aligns with your needs.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
